mainEntity.name: How long does it take to construct a granny apartment addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline varies according to project scope, site preparation, and permitting steps. Garage conversions and interior renovations typically move through construction faster because the exterior structure exists. Building a full room addition or standalone dwelling requires site preparation, foundation pouring, rough framing, roofing, and exterior stucco or siding before interior drywall, plumbing, and electrical finishes begin. Permitting reviews and initial design consultations also require dedicated time before construction crews break ground. Your general contractor will establish a milestone schedule covering every phase from initial layout planning to final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines depend on scope; interior renovations move faster, while ground-up additions require extra weeks for foundations, framing, exterior finishes, and interior installations.
